definitions.explanation: The sky as seen at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{夜空|よぞら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{咲|さ}いた→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: The fireworks bloomed beautifully in the night sky.

examples.japanese: {夜空|よぞら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：00770_hoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いている→輝く：01238_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The stars are shining in the night sky.

examples.japanese: {夜空|よぞら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見上|みあ}げた→見上げる：02113_miageru⟧。
examples.english: I looked up at the night sky.

notes:
{夜空|よぞら} is a compound of {夜|よる} (night) + {空|そら} (sky).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜空|よぞら}に{輝|かがや}く: to shine in the night sky
- {夜空|よぞら}を{見上|みあ}げる: to look up at the night sky
- {満天|まんてん}の{星空|ほしぞら}: sky full of stars

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {青空|あおぞら}: blue sky
- {星空|ほしぞら}: starry sky
- {大空|おおぞら}: wide sky, firmament
